capabilities: Create and open a note for any folder
Keep folder and note names in sync on rename
Turn the current note into a folder
Insert card overviews of folder contents
Set starting content for new folder notes
extras: Installs under a new plugin ID next to the original, so the original must be disabled; settings can be copied from the original's data.json. Detailed ccard syntax and recipes are documented outside the README. Auto Rename is marked experimental.
intentEvidence: A revamp of xpgo's Folder Note plugin, kept working with current Obsidian.
motivation: The original xpgo Folder Note plugin has not been updated since 2021 and no longer loads in current Obsidian, so the author rebuilt it to keep working.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to give a folder its own note for descriptions or links, and the original Folder Note plugin no longer loads in current versions.

relations.evidence: A revamp of xpgo's Folder Note plugin, kept working with current Obsidian.
The two plugins complement each other: Folder Note Revamped creates and manages the folder note, and Waypoint fills it
Automatic overviews of a folder's contents, like Trilium does (partly done).

summary: Revamp of the Folder Note plugin that attaches a note to each folder and can render card overviews of a folder's contents.
